verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships its own background automation. Per-customer ongoing monitoring can be switched on via API, and agentic workflows (screening/monitoring and transaction monitoring agents) auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate complex cases. These are fixed compliance-domain automations rather than general user-defined ones, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Webhooks and the batch API are integration building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation/rule builder, documented scheduling or trigger configuration for agents, depth on how autonomous agents are set up and governed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
